steps.caption: Open Nimbus Ledger Systems from Companies.
Open the Intelligence panel, then Relationship history.
Open the full timeline to read the notes.
Show only conversations: choose Event type 'Conversation'.
July: 'They prefer a Grade A building with immediate occupancy.'
September: the same again after the site visits.
October: and again on the requirement call. Three separate notes, three sources.
Now ask AI about the requirement. Open Ask AI.
Ask: has the Nimbus Ledger requirement changed?
Open 'Worked through' to read the full answer from the records.
At the end: 'Recurring preferences (not confirmed requirements): Grade A, immediate occupancy.'
A note captured twice counts once — only independent notes make it recurring.
Now the requirement itself. Open it from Requirements.
Current requirement holds only what the client confirmed: area, location, move-in, budget.
Building grade and fit-out are still Unknown — the preference was not copied in. Confirm it with the client first.
